profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Optro
profile.summary: Everyday is an opportunity to strengthen my passion and expand my knowledge for programming, games, virtual worlds, and social networking.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build/deploy/maintain microservice integrations connecting external APIs to internal systems using NodeJS
- Design and code API specifications for both internal and external uses
- Program new features into the ShipStation SaaS product

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- C# / .NET 
- SQL
- Code/deploy fixes for user reported bugs and issues
- Develop/maintain development and troubleshooting tools used by other departments internally

positions.title: Escalations Manager
positions.description:
- Directs the activities of the User Escalation team to reduce User account churn and improve User satisfaction.

- Leads and coaches User Escalation staff to improve individual skills and success metrics.
Supports Users for all system inquiries, including extensive troubleshooting and general questions. 

- Handles and resolves escalated user issues and complaints.

- Collaborates with developer support and other departments as needed to resolve customer issues quickly and concisely with a regard to the entire system and all users. Provides all necessary information clearly to other departments to ensure efficient handling.

- Maintains expert skills on the ShipStation platform to provide training and coaching for staff.

positions.title: Game Tester
positions.description:
-Play testing game play functionality to include mechanics, audio, achievements, VFX, lighting, textures, and stability

-Performing regressions on closed/resolved ticketed bugs to ensure integrity in the build 

-Process, track, and report bugs using detailed oriented strategies and test plans

-Working with developers to reproduce, problem solve, and fix critical issues in all stages of the game build

-Reporting and researching ticketed bugs in a database using Microsoft Visual Studio

-Submitting meticulously detailed game issues based on defined studio standards into bug tracking system

-Presenting objective and professional criticism on gameplay related issues in both written and verbal formats

-Completing assigned test plans and discovering critical game issues (bugs)

-Aids in measuring and prioritizing game issues and concerns with peers and to senior team members

-Rigorously testing and verifying bug fixes and regressions

positions.title: Lifestyles and Video Game Manager
positions.description:
-Raised department sales 30% over previous years sales goal

-Managed and overseeing applications and resumes in order to schedule and interview potential new employees to help complete our team.  

-Managed 15+ employees on daily tasks as well as scheduling and training

positions.title: Front Counter Customer Service Manager
positions.description:
-Managed customer traffic by providing service checkout, returns, exchanges and buybacks

-Audited and recorded daily sales deposits in excess of $10,000 

-Managed and held accountable for new hire training and record keeping

projects.title: Reddit Scraper
projects.description: A simple scraping site that scraps popular space subreddits for images and displays them on the page.
